response.sql: WITH race_stats AS (SELECT raceId, AVG(points) as avg_points, AVG(wins) as avg_wins FROM constructorStandings WHERE points > 6.0 GROUP BY raceId), overall_stats AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) as overall_avg_wins FROM race_stats WHERE avg_wins IS NOT NULL) SELECT rs.raceId, rs.avg_points, rs.avg_wins, rs.avg_wins - os.overall_avg_wins as difference FROM race_stats rs CROSS JOIN overall_stats os WHERE os.overall_avg_wins IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: "Clear the 6.0-point threshold" means strictly greater than 6.0 (points > 6.0), not greater than or equal to (>= 6.0)
